definitionZh: 标记中间的CSS属性指向在元素路径的中间顶点上绘制的标记;即在其起始顶点和结束顶点之间的每个顶点上. 标记必须是使用 SVG 元素定义的,只能以 URL 值来引用 。 CSS属性的值凌驾于SVG中标记中间属性的任何值.
sourceDefinition: The marker-mid CSS property points to a marker that will be drawn on the middle vertices of the element's path; that is, at each of its vertices between the start and end vertices. The marker must have been defined using an SVG element, and can only be referenced with a urlvalue value. The value of the CSS property overrides any values of the marker-mid attribute in the SVG.
